classification: routine preparation of synthetic expected results for IMP-08; this file is NOT a production calculation engine and NOT real economic evidence

canonicalCases.C01: Trades means 100 and midpoints means 104 -> proxy 101 by 0.75x100+0.25x104; no VWAP added.
canonicalCases.C02: Only trades / only midpoints / no source -> single source / missing if no observations after the permitted fallback.
canonicalCases.C03: Daily references 100 and 110 with different tick densities -> B=105; equal weight per date.
canonicalCases.C04: Proxy 100 replaced by official 102; second date 110 -> new B=106 and prior receipt preserved.
canonicalCases.C05: Official correction 102->103; second date 110 -> new B=106.5; selection by latest provider timestamp.
canonicalCases.C06: Missing date later receives official -> recompute set, sum, denominator and coverage.
canonicalCases.C07: 1-0-1/3-1-3 boundaries and fallback +/-60 minutes -> start included / end excluded; correct calendar, zone/DST, availability and labels.
canonicalCases.C08: Official 0.01 -> test the reported guard and applicable validity; do not presume rejecting it is correct.
canonicalCases.C09: V=+4,-1 -> n=2; p=0.5; mu=1.5; R=C=4; sigma_down=1; Sortino=1.5.
canonicalCases.C10: V=+3,-1 -> mu=1; R=C=3; Sortino=1: does not pass >1 strict.
canonicalCases.C12: Only positives; exact-zero; n<2; empty group -> explicit undefined case and application of 5, with no epsilon and no artificial PASS.

frozenDecisions: n_nonzero is the n of the scoring formulas; n_total and n_neutral are reported separately and never substituted for n.
Downside denominator is n-1, not n and not n_minus-1.
Target T=0; no annualization; no epsilon.
Quarterly statistical screen is Sortino>1 strict; C is diagnostic only and is not a hard research gate.
Quarterly and Monthly are separate; Monthly never inherits the Quarterly Sortino screen.
Benchmark daily weights are equal per included date; official/proxy/fill remain distinct.
V=B-H in compatible units; unknown fees are never replaced by zero; incomplete coverage is reported separately and is not valid research.
Historical versions and point-in-time views are preserved; corrections create new versions and never rewrite prior values.
No research PASS and no authority is produced by these synthetic fixtures.
mustNotChange: downside n-1, target 0, no annualization/epsilon, strict Sortino>1
benchmark daily equal weights and windows
Monthly never inherits the Quarterly screen

units.note: B, H and V are unit-compatible per 5.5. Total EUR requires a compatible MWh volume; MW is not converted to MWh in any fixture.

globalAssumptions: All values, dates, timestamps and sources in this file are synthetic and explicitly labelled; rows/fuentes are assumed valid only for the described synthetic case.
Timestamps are synthetic calendar examples used to test inclusive/exclusive boundaries, not verified market dates.
The timezone declared for boundary fixtures is Europe/Berlin (CET/CEST); its DST switch 2026-03-29 is used only as an arithmetic example.
H is an explicitly supplied synthetic all-in value with unit and coverage metadata; no universally valid real-ledger H formula or denominator is invented.
Source procedures cited by the SPEC are treated as assumptions confined to fixtures, not audited market facts.
Missing real inputs remain outside this synthetic phase.

specSource.quote: El proxy utiliza filas accesibles y deduplicadas del producto y fecha exactos: m_j=(bid_j+ask_j)/2, T_hat=(1/n)sum p_i, M_hat=(1/k)sum m_j, R_hat_d=0.75T_hat+0.25M_hat si trades y midpoints.

specSource.quote: La fila oficial valida tiene prioridad... La sustitucion oficial sobre derivado cambia la version de evaluacion, nunca la decision view historica ni los fills originales.

fixtures.derivation: Official row for date1 (102) replaces the derived proxy (100). New sum=102+110=212; new B=212/2=106. The prior receipt B=105 is preserved as a separate historical version; it is not overwritten.

specSource.quote: Entre correcciones oficiales prevalece el timestamp de proveedor mas reciente.

fixtures.derivation: Two official rows for date1: 102 at an earlier provider timestamp and 103 at the latest timestamp. The latest (103) is selected. New sum=103+110=213; new B=213/2=106.5. The 102 version remains preserved historically.

specSource.quote: Fechas missing no se rellenan con cero... Su aparicion posterior exige recalcular conjunto y denominador, conservando cobertura y versiones anteriores.

fixtures.derivation: Version1: date2 missing -> |D_t|=1, sum=100, B=100, coverage 1/2. Version2: date2 receives official 110 -> |D_t|=2, sum=210, B=105, coverage 2/2. The denominator, sum and coverage all change; the prior version is preserved.
